body:
Courageous leaders of previous generations have opened many doors, and today’s emerging trailblazers are walking through them. They aren’t waiting for anyone’s permission. They have all the permission they need. A great theological migration has begun.

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016)
